service.description: The requester adds or edits the reason after the fact, from the request page. Allowed while the request is pending, or later only to fill a reason that was missing, so a recorded reason is never rewritten after the decision.

return.message: Only the requester can change the reason of a request.
The reason can no longer be changed once the request is decided.

service.description: The "New change request" screen, for any entity that has guarded fields in Setup: changes a guarded field, or adds or deletes a record, with a mandatory reason, through the entity's normal create/update/delete service so the gate holds it (or, with break-glass, lets it through and records it).

parameter.name: recordKey
parameter.description: JSON of the primary key (Update, Delete)

service.description: Replays an approved request: stale check, then the stored service call as the approver with the gate switched off for this call only. The replay runs in its own transaction so a failure rolls back the change but still lets us record CcrFailed.
Puts a Failed request back to Approved; a post-commit SECA then runs apply# again. Helps when the failure was transient. A stale record fails again: cancel it and have the change submitted again.

return.message: You are not an approver for configuration changes.
Only failed requests can be retried (status is ${ccr.statusId}).

service.description: Internal: called by the gate (ApprovalGate.groovy) after a break-glass change has been applied directly. Saves it as an already Applied request so approvers can review it; a tx-commit SECA tells them.

actions.script: Timestamp now = ec.user.nowTimestamp def ccr = ec.entity.makeValue("co.hotwax.configapproval.ConfigChangeRequest") ccr.setAll([changeSourceEnumId: "CcsBreakGlass", changeTypeEnumId: changeTypeEnumId, entityName: entityName, pkJson: pkJson, serviceName: serviceName, parametersJson: parametersJson, originalJson: originalJson, diffJson: diffJson, summaryText: summaryText, reason: reason, reasonMissing: "N", plannedFixDate: plannedFixDate, statusId: "CcrApplied", requestedByUserId: ec.user.userId, requestedDate: now, decidedByUserId: ec.user.userId, decidedDate: now, appliedDate: now, decisionComment: "Break-glass: applied immediately", requestChannel: requestChannel]) ccr.setSequencedIdPrimary(); ccr.create() requestId = ccr.requestId

service.description: Email about a request: approval needed (to approvers except the requester) or the outcome (to the requester). Never fails the caller: a mail problem is logged and cleared.

Scheduled (ServiceJob ConfigApproval_Sweep). Expires pending requests past their expire date, and reminds approvers once about requests still waiting after config.approval.reminder.hours (default 24). Expiring never changes the target record: the change was simply never approved.
Switch a guarded field on or off (Enumeration.optionValue N = off)
Guard another field. entityName.fieldName must exist; secret hides the values in requests and emails.

OMS only. maarg-util's OfbizShiroRealm rebuilds each user's Moqui groups from the OFBiz security groups at every login and expires any membership that has no OFBiz group behind it, so a CONFIG_APPROVERS membership kept only in Moqui is lost at the user's next login. Mirror it as an OFBiz SecurityGroup + MaargSecGrp mapping + UserLoginSecurityGroup so the sync keeps it. Does nothing where those entities do not exist (e.g. a plain Moqui runtime).
